snippets.POOL_UPDATE_LIFEGUARD_01: Hi $$name$$! Great to see you! If you'd like to get a cool new swimsuit, you have to find the three different parts.
snippets.POOL_UPDATE_LIFEGUARD_02: You need swimming goggles, armbands, and a bathing suit. These are hidden somewhere in Panfu.
snippets.POOL_UPDATE_LIFEGUARD_03: Bring all the pieces to me and I'll give you the finished swimming suit.
snippets.POOL_UPDATE_LIFEGUARD_04: You can find the swimming goggles today. You'll be able to find a different piece tomorrow.
snippets.POOL_UPDATE_LIFEGUARD_05: Today you can find the swimming goggles and the armbands. You'll be able to find the next piece tomorrow.
snippets.POOL_UPDATE_LIFEGUARD_06: Today you can find the swimming goggles, the armbands, and the swimming suit.
snippets.POOL_UPDATE_LIFEGUARD_07: Great! You've found all of the parts. Now you'll get your complete swimsuit, which you can wear in the pool.
snippets.POOL_UPDATE_MESSAGE_01: You've received an item. Go to the lifeguard at the swimming pool.
snippets.POOL_UPDATE_WAIT_TOMORROW: Come visit me again in one day
